name: EM Carry-to-Vol Ranking: BRL, MXN, ZAR
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, and ZAR by carry-to-volatility ratio. Carry = 3-month interbank rate minus US Fed Funds. Volatility = 60-day annualized realized vol of FX returns. Higher ratio = more attractive risk-adjusted carry.
source:
# EM Carry-to-Vol Ranking: BRL, MXN, ZAR
# Carry = 3M interbank rate - US Fed Funds
# Vol = 60-day annualized realized vol of FX returns
# Ratio = carry / vol → higher = more attractive risk-adjusted carry

# --- Data: FX prices ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Data: Interest rates (shared context, monthly → ffill to daily) ---
# Brazil 3M interbank (SELIC proxy)
brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()
brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)

# Mexico 3M interbank (TIIE)
mxn_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01MXM156N')()
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_rate_raw.result)

# South Africa 3M interbank
zar_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')()
zar_rate = ffill(zar_rate_raw.result)

# US Fed Funds rate
us_rate_raw = common_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.FedFunds)()
us_rate = ffill(us_rate_raw.result)

# --- Route correct EM rate to each asset ---
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker='^USDBRL')()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker='^USDMXN')()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker='^USDZAR')()

# Assign EM rate per asset using conditional_select
em_rate = conditional_select(
    is_brl.result, brl_rate,
    is_mxn.result, mxn_rate,
    is_zar.result, zar_rate,
    0.0)

# --- Carry: EM rate minus US rate (percentage points) ---
carry = em_rate - us_rate

# --- Volatility: 60-day annualized realized vol ---
# basic_volatility returns annualized vol as decimal fraction
vol_60d = basic_volatility(period=60)(close)

# --- Carry-to-Vol Ratio ---
# Guard against division by zero/NaN vol
carry_to_vol = where(is_valid(vol_60d) and vol_60d > 0.001, carry / (vol_60d * 100.0))

# Note: vol_60d is decimal (e.g., 0.15 = 15%), carry is in percentage points (e.g., 8.0).
# To make units comparable: carry (pct pts) / (vol * 100 = vol in pct pts)
# Result: ratio in "carry points per vol point" — higher = better

# --- Cross-sectional rank (1 = lowest carry/vol, 3 = highest) ---
carry_rank = cs_rank(ascending=True)(carry_to_vol)

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
ts = index()()

# --- Output 1: Carry/Vol Ratio Over Time (ranking evolution) ---
cs_lines(
    title='Which EM Currency Offers the Best Risk-Adjusted Carry?',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Vol Ratio',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='EM Carry',
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Emerald],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 2: Current Snapshot — Who's on Top? ---
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Current Carry-to-Vol Ranking',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Vol Ratio',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='EM Carry',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=carry_to_vol)

# --- Output 3: Summary Table — Carry, Vol, Ratio Details ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='EM Carry Components',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    category='EM Carry',
    order=0,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='EM Carry Components',
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='EM Rate (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='US Rate (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry (ppt)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='60d Vol (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry/Vol', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rank', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0)
        ]
    )
)(em_rate, us_rate, carry, vol_60d * 100.0, carry_to_vol, carry_rank)
